data.name: Audio Adventurers
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a mystical quest to master the art of sound!

Audio Adventurers is an educational game that transforms audio engineering training into an epic adventure. Battle through ten enchanted lands, each designed to sharpen a different audio skill—from frequency recognition to intuiting amplitude, hearing compression, identifying reverberation, remembering mix hierarchies, and more.

Master 10 Audio Realms

  • Frequency Forest - Train your ears to identify specific frequencies

  • The Grove of Gain - Identify changes in amplitude

  • Distortion Double Duel - Recognize distortion

  • Fader Fields - Master precise level adjustments

  • Compression Coven - Learn the sound of audio compression

  • Cut Cliffs - Identify filter cutoff frequencies

  • Panning Pasture - Develop stereo imaging skills

  • Reverb Ravine - Distinguish reverb characteristics

  • Mix Memory Meadow - Intuit the balance of mixes

  • Synth Serpentwood - Re-create synthesized sounds

Perfect for:

  • Audio engineering students

  • Music producers developing their skills

  • Sound designers honing their craft

  • Anyone curious about how sound works

Features: ✓ Progressive difficulty that adapts to your skill level ✓ Comprehensive leaderboard and achievement system ✓ Class code system for educators ✓ Hundreds of carefully crafted audio samples ✓ Colorful fantasy world ✓ No prior audio knowledge required—learn as you play!

Teacher Tools: Audio instructors can easily incorporate this game into their curricula. Any teacher can easily generate a "Class Code" that will link all their students together, and check-in on their practice or grade their progress with a simple download of a .csv shreadsheet.

Whether you're a beginner exploring audio for the first time or a seasoned professional looking to sharpen your golden ears, Audio Adventurers makes ear training engaging, challenging, and fun.

The adventure begins now. Can you unlock the legendary Golden Ears?

data.short_description: Master critical listening skills through a fantasy-themed adventure! Battle through 10 magical realms that sharpen your ability to hear frequencies, compression, reverb, mixing, and synthesis. Perfect for aspiring audio engineers, producers, and sound designers. Train your ears, save the world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (dual core) or AMD Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible, 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible, stereo output required
  • Additional Notes: Headphones or quality speakers required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (quad core) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible, stereo output required
  • Additional Notes: Headphones or quality speakers required

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 dual core OR Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio, stereo output required
  • Additional Notes: Headphones or quality speakers required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio, stereo output required
  • Additional Notes: Headphones or quality speakers required
